evals.prompt: I want to detect people in my camera feeds and see alerts on a dashboard. Not sure what tech to use.
evals.expected_output: Runs a short business-objective Q&A (outcome, inputs, deployment target, hardware, dashboard), discovers that this maps to the metro-ai-apps-recipe skill, proposes a plan (person-detection Docker stack + inferred model/device/topics) and waits for confirmation before delegating the build.
expectations: Asks only business questions, never which framework/model/precision/device to use
Maps the objective to metro-ai-apps-recipe via references/SKILL_CATALOG.md
Presents a plan with deliverable + chosen skill + inferred technology and waits for explicit confirmation
Builds nothing before approval, then delegates to metro-ai-apps-recipe rather than re-implementing the stack

evals.prompt: I want employees to ask questions in plain English against our internal PDFs.
evals.expected_output: Q&A establishes a document-grounded chatbot on Docker; discovery routes to chatqna-docker-deploy; plan includes the npx skills@1.5.23 add install command and waits for confirmation before deploying.
expectations: Routes a RAG/Q&A-over-documents objective to chatqna-docker-deploy (or chatqna-helm-deploy for Kubernetes)
Includes the exact `npx skills@1.5.23 add open-edge-platform/skills --skill chatqna-docker-deploy` install step, run only after approval
Surfaces requirements (Docker, RAM) in the plan
Delegates the deploy to the chatqna skill and verifies against its criteria

evals.prompt: I have hundreds of recorded videos and want to type a phrase and jump to matching clips.
evals.expected_output: Discovery sequences vdms-dataprep-user (ingest) -> vss-deploy --search -> vss-search-index (query); plan confirms the whole pipeline once before building.
expectations: Recognizes a video-search objective and selects vss-deploy plus supporting vdms-dataprep-user and vss-search-index
Chooses search mode (not summary) from the business answers
Sequences supporting skills in dependency order and confirms the whole pipeline once
Offers vss-deploy-helm when the target is Kubernetes

evals.prompt: I have a labeled defect dataset and want a quantized model ready for Intel edge.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the getitune-* training pipeline (discover -> prepare -> train -> export -> optimize -> run) and offers a follow-on deploy path via model-download-user + metro-ai-apps-recipe.
expectations: Maps a training objective to the getitune-* skills, not a deployment skill
Sequences discover/prepare/train/export/optimize/inference steps
Selects INT8 quantization via NNCF when the user wants edge speed
Suggests the natural follow-on deployment path once the IR exists

evals.prompt: I want to use AI with my cameras, not sure where to start.
evals.expected_output: Because the objective is ambiguous, asks a business disambiguation (spot/count vs search/summarize vs cross-camera tracking) before routing; may present two candidate plans; never guesses a full build.
expectations: Detects an under-specified objective and clarifies in business terms before routing
Uses references/SKILL_CATALOG.md to branch to metro-ai-apps-recipe, vss-*, or scenescape-setup
Does not fabricate skills and does not build before a clear objective is confirmed

evals.prompt: Run the metro-ai-apps-recipe skill to build a smart-parking stack in ./smart-parking-stack.
evals.expected_output: The user already named a concrete skill, so the orchestrator should NOT own the conversation — it defers to metro-ai-apps-recipe directly.
expectations: Recognizes a directly-named skill and hands off instead of running its own Q&A/discovery flow
